parameters.query: SELECT employee_no, full_name, department, status, first_in, late_minutes FROM attendance.daily_summary WHERE day = '2026-01-02' AND (status = 'LATE' OR status = 'REMOTE' OR late_minutes > 0) LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.title AS subject, d.sender_address AS from_address, d.project_code, c.content FROM rag.chunk c JOIN rag.document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.source_type = 'EMAIL' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
